concepts.gloss_en: The 'brain/mind' as expressed in relation to the ears (hearing the words of the wise)
The 'brain/mind' as expressed in relation to the nose (fear of God, 'beginning of wisdom')
The 'brain/mind' as expressed in relation to the eyes (the eyes being opened)
The 'brain/mind' as expressed in relation to the mouth ('the beginning of Your word is truth')

notes: All four share the frame 'the brain/mind spoken of in connection with X' but the construct head organ differs (ears/nose/eyes/mouth). Per rule 4, different associated organs = different concepts; token overlap is only the shared idiom, not identity. Keep all separate.
